svg.title: Regional ranks, push share and volume, 2020 to 2026
svg.desc: Each ribbon is a region. Its vertical position follows rank among six regions each quarter from 2020 Q1 to 2026 Q1. The upper panel's width shows its percentage of public pushes across 149 economies; the lower panel's width shows quarterly public pushes in millions. One width scale is used across all years within each panel, but the two panels have different units. Ribbons do not represent activity moving between regions.
